verdict.rationale: New Relic offers automation-adjacent features such as alerts, notifications, and automated remediation, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never documents versioning, review, or rollback of those automations. The Terraform evidence covers declarative management of agent fleets, not version history or rollback of automations, and any versioning through Terraform would be a user-side git workflow rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
